subject: mathematics
title: Round 47 to 50
objective: Round numbers to the nearest ten, hundred, or thousand.
introduction: Milo is rolling number cards to the nearest ten, hundred, or thousand. Which place will each card land on?

vocabulary.definition: The ones digit is 7, so 47 moves up to 50.
The tens digit is 4, so 342 stays at the lower hundred, 300.
The hundreds digit is 6, so 3,650 moves up to 4,000.

items.explanation: 47 is between 40 and 50. The ones digit is 7, and 5 or more rounds up, so 47 rounds to 50.
342 is between 300 and 400. The tens digit is 4, and 4 or less stays down, so 342 rounds to 300.
3,650 is between 3,000 and 4,000. The hundreds digit is 6, and 5 or more rounds up, so 3,650 rounds to 4,000.
1,241 is between 1,200 and 1,300. The tens digit is 4, and 4 or less stays down, so 1,241 rounds to 1,200.

items.prompt: Which statement about rounding is true?
items.explanation: 47 has a ones digit of 7, so it rounds up to 50. A ones digit of 0–4 would round down instead.
